A coworker is several meters ahead near the timber’s far end, positioned to help guide or carry it; neither person appears to be blocking the other, and the route ahead is open. Because the timber is long and awkward, lifting and carrying it together is safer and more socially appropriate than attempting to move it alone. No boxes or clear doorway are visible.
